additionalTables.purpose: The rebuildable unit vector of a claim's current text (or the record that its route returned no usable vector) follows its claim (claim_id in ownedClaims): it is deleted with a project's claims and kept with every other claim. It does not own the shared model space. A claim's captured embedding inputs (Host artifacts of derived kind KnowledgeEmbeddingInput naming the claim, in any scope) are deleted with the project's claims as owned lineage (ownedKnowledgeInferenceArtifacts), and the expression index artifacts_knowledge_embedding_input adds no table or ownership edge.
